source.scope: Six months using cleansing oil, cleanser, toner and sunscreen; four-product routine, not a sunscreen-only trial.

milestones: 3–4 weeks: routine check-in for hydration and comfort
2–3 months: consistent routine and review of complexion
implementation.attribution: Visible routine-experience labels and direct source links. Individual experiences vary.
implementation.clinicalEvidence: Existing 12–52-week SPF appearance study and 4.5-year daily-sunscreen trial retained.

presentation.approach: Routine-experience panel beside existing published-sunscreen evidence

learning: Use personal routine accounts as attributed experiences or check-in prompts, preserving the distinction from product clinical testing and guaranteed outcome timing.
